evals.name: equal-cards-dashboard
evals.prompt: 这是我们内部运维监控平台的首页，用 React + Tailwind 写的。现在页面是 2x3 六张一样大的卡片：CPU 使用率、内存、磁盘、最近告警、服务列表、快捷操作。值班同事说看着像 demo，出了问题第一眼找不到。帮我重新排一下，品牌色 #0F766E 要保留，功能都不能少。
evals.expected_output: 先写出用户在此页的任务（值班时发现并定位告警），把最近告警和异常服务作为主体，资源指标压缩为顶部一行读数，快捷操作合并进工具栏或行内；给出前后对照说明、文字/色彩/间距角色表（标注临时基线）、以及分开记录的实查项和未验证项。不应输出六张换了颜色的等大卡片。
expectations: States the page's user task in one sentence (e.g. on-call engineer must spot and locate a problem) before proposing layout
Alerts and/or abnormal services become the visually dominant area; the six modules are no longer an equal-size 2x3 grid
CPU/memory/disk are compressed into one compact readout row instead of three full cards
Quick actions are merged into a toolbar or inline row actions, not kept as a standalone card
All original functions remain: cpu, mem, disk, alerts, service list, restart, view logs, silence, export
Brand color #0F766E is kept and used sparingly for primary action/identity, not painted on every number
Numeric readouts use tabular-nums (font-variant-numeric or Tailwind tabular-nums)
Response separates what was checked from what was not, and does not claim the page was rendered or screenshot-verified
Response explains specific improvements (what moved where and why), not just 'made it cleaner'

evals.name: local-fix-number-jitter
evals.prompt: SwiftUI 写的一个充电桩状态页，顶部有个大字显示当前功率 kW，数字每秒刷新，刷新时旁边的单位和右边的暂停按钮会左右抖。只想解决这个抖动，别的别动。
evals.expected_output: 识别为局部修正模式，不做整页重排。根因是比例字体数字宽度变化，修法是等宽数字（monospacedDigit）加按最大位数预留宽度或固定 frame，单位与数字保持邻近。交付是一段代码加一句根因说明，不附带整套设计规范。
expectations: Fix applies monospacedDigit() (or an equivalent tabular-figures setting) to the power number
Reserves a stable width for the number (fixed/min frame, hidden max-width placeholder, or equivalent) so the unit and button stop moving
Only the power readout HStack changes; the session-info row and overall layout are untouched
Response is a short root-cause explanation plus the change; no design spec, priority table or full-page redesign is delivered
Does not claim to have built, run or visually verified the app

evals.name: review-settings-page
evals.prompt: 帮我看看这个 Android 设置页（Compose）有什么视觉问题，截图我发不了，代码在 app/src/main/java/com/example/settings/SettingsScreen.kt。里面用的颜色是 #9E9E9E 的辅助文字、#EEEEEE 的分隔线、每个设置项各自一张带阴影的 Card，标题字号 16sp 正文也是 16sp。
evals.expected_output: 评审模式。按影响排序列出问题：#9E9E9E 对白底约 2.7:1 不满足 4.5:1（用脚本算过，写完整精度）；标题和正文同字号导致层级缺失；连续设置项不应每项一张带阴影的卡片，应改为列表行加细分隔；分隔线作为唯一边界时对比度不足。每条写位置、现象、影响和建议。没有截图的部分明确标注为待查，不宣称已验证渲染。
expectations: Flags #9E9E9E secondary text as failing 4.5:1 with a computed ratio (about 2.7:1), not just 'too light'
Flags that title and body are both 16sp, i.e. no type hierarchy
Recommends replacing per-item elevated Cards with list rows (plus divider/spacing) because settings items are continuous, not independent objects
Comments on the #EEEEEE divider: decorative-only or insufficient as the only boundary
Issues are explicitly ordered by impact (readability/operation first, consistency next, polish last)
Explicitly states what could not be verified without a screenshot/render, marking such items as pending rather than confirmed
Each issue names a code location or element (e.g. SecondaryText, Card elevation, Text fontSize) so the user can find it

evals.name: from-scratch-gym-dashboard
evals.prompt: 用 Vue 3 + Tailwind 帮我写一个健身房会员管理后台的首页，前台小妹每天上班开着用。要展示：今日到店人数、本月新增会员、即将到期会员、今日课程排期、教练列表、本月收入趋势、待办事项、公告。先出一版能跑的单文件组件。
evals.expected_output: 先写出前台每天的主任务（接待到店、处理续费/到期提醒），据此让即将到期会员或今日课程/到店成为主体，收入趋势和公告降为辅助；不是八个等大卡片。写明主任务是假设、若主要用户是老板则主体不同。数字用等宽数字。不为占位而硬编码假图表数据冒充真实。
expectations: States who the primary user is and what they do on this page every day before deciding layout, and flags it as an assumption
The eight modules are NOT rendered as an equal-size uniform card grid; at least one module is clearly dominant in area or position
The dominant module is one the stated task needs continuously (e.g. 即将到期会员, 今日课程, 今日到店), and 公告 / 收入趋势 are visibly subordinate
Numeric readouts use tabular-nums
Any sample data is clearly labelled as placeholder/props to be replaced, not hardcoded inside the template as if real
Response states what was not verified (no browser render) and offers what would change if the primary user were the owner instead

evals.name: design-md-compliance
evals.prompt: 这个发票列表页看着不够精致，帮我按项目规范整理一下，顺便让它好看点。规范在 DESIGN.md，页面是 invoices.html。
evals.expected_output: 以 DESIGN.md 为准：品牌色 #FF9900 换成 #B45309 且只用于主按钮，圆角统一 4px，去掉 box-shadow 而不是加，字号只用 20/14/12，间距 8 步进，行高 40px。'好看点'通过对齐（金额右对齐等宽数字）、层级、留白实现，不引入规范外的阴影渐变字号。不修改 DESIGN.md。
expectations: Brand color #FF9900 is replaced by #B45309 and used only on the primary button (新建发票) and nothing else
box-shadow is removed and NOT replaced by any new shadow, gradient or blur; hierarchy uses background + 1px #E5E7EB border
All border-radius values are 4px (status pill included)
Only font sizes 20/14/12 px appear in the CSS; 22/13/11 are gone
Amount column is right-aligned with tabular-nums
DESIGN.md is not modified
Response explains which DESIGN.md rules were applied and does not propose changing the spec to get a prettier result

evals.name: empty-page-fill-trap
evals.prompt: 这个 RN 的「我的设备」页太空了，只有一个列表和一个按钮，帮我填充一下让它看起来丰富点，老板明天要看 demo。
evals.expected_output: 不添加不存在的功能和假统计；用真实字段（名称、型号、在线状态）建立层级，设计好的空态/引导态和单设备态，可能加设备状态的视觉表达。若为 demo 提供示例数据，必须明确标为示例并与真实状态分离。说明未渲染。
expectations: No new features are invented (no fake energy stats, weather, tips, notifications, charts or firmware info that the Device type does not carry)
Richness comes from the real fields: name, model, online state (e.g. status dot + text, grouping, larger touch rows, better empty state)
The empty state is designed as a first-run/onboarding state with the add action as the primary element, not a bare '暂无设备'
If demo/sample data is provided, it is clearly labelled as sample and lives outside the component (props/fixture), not hardcoded inside the screen
Response explicitly tells the user it did not add fabricated content and why, while still addressing the demo need
Response states rendering was not verified

evals.name: 3x-redline-to-points
evals.prompt: 设计师给的 iPhone 15 Pro 标注（3x 切图）：卡片圆角 36px，左右边距 48px，标题 66px PingFang SC Semibold，副标题 42px 灰色，价格 96px Bold 品牌色 #FF5A5F，按钮高度 144px 圆角 72px。帮我在 PlanCard.swift 里按标注实现这个卡片。
evals.expected_output: 把 3x 像素换算为逻辑点：圆角 12、边距 16、标题 22、副标题 14、价格 32、按钮高 48 圆角 24。用系统字体或 Dynamic Type 相对字号，不把 66 直接写进代码。说明换算依据，指出未在设备上验证。
expectations: All redline pixel values are divided by 3 before use: radius 12, margin 16, title 22, subtitle 14, price 32, button height 48 / radius 24
No raw 3x numbers (36, 48 as margin, 66, 42, 96, 144, 72) appear as SwiftUI point values
Text uses system font (or a Dynamic Type text style / scaled metric), not a hardcoded font file, and mentions font scaling
Price uses monospacedDigit or explains why not needed
Response explains the 3x -> pt conversion so the user can check the designer's redline next time
Response states it was not built or run on a device

evals.name: ai-look-color-cleanup
evals.prompt: 这个概览页是 AI 帮我生成的，功能都对，但同事说一看就是 AI 做的，颜色太花了。帮我把配色调舒服一点，布局和内容不用大动。文件是 Overview.html。
evals.expected_output: 识别出'用颜色冒充重要性'的根因：紫色渐变页头和背景、四张彩虹指标卡、每行一个渐变图标底块、渐变文字、发光阴影、emoji 标题。改成明度分层（页面底 + 白色表面）、一种强调色、指标卡同一表面色、图标去底块改单线或去掉、渐变全部去掉、状态标签用同色相浅底配深字并算对比度。布局结构保持不变。说明每处为什么改，并注明未渲染。
expectations: All gradients are removed: no bg-gradient-*, linear-gradient or bg-clip-text gradient text remains
The four KPI cards share one neutral surface color; per-card blue/green/amber/pink backgrounds and colored shadows are gone
Task-row icon tiles (colored/gradient squares behind emoji) are removed or replaced by a single neutral icon style, not one color per row

Only one accent color remains for primary action/selection; status chips keep semantic colors with same-hue dark text on light tint (e.g. red-700 on red-50), and the response reports their contrast ratios
Glow/colored box-shadows and backdrop-blur on ordinary cards are removed; hierarchy comes from page-bg vs surface luminance plus spacing
Emoji used as section/list icons are removed or replaced with a consistent icon approach
Layout structure (header, KPI row, 2:1 main grid) is preserved; the change is confined to color, decoration and icon treatment
Response names the root cause (color used to fake importance) and explains each replacement, and states rendering was not verified

evals.name: dark-mode-layering
evals.prompt: 这个深色模式的监控页看着刺眼，卡片和背景也分不清层次，帮我把颜色调一下。文件 monitor.html。
evals.expected_output: 页面底不用纯黑，表面比页面底亮一档，浮起的告警弹层再亮一档并用 1px 边线代替发光阴影。去掉青色发光阴影。强调色从霓虹青降饱和度，只用于刷新按钮和在线状态；离线和告警改用语义色而不是品红和荧光绿。文字不用纯白，用三档灰并逐对算对比度，slate-500/600 在深色底上不达标要提亮。只改颜色。
expectations: Page background is no longer pure black; surfaces are lighter than the page and the fixed alert panel is lighter still or bordered, i.e. elevation reads as lightness steps
All glow box-shadows are removed; elevation uses a 1px lighter border or a small neutral shadow
Accent cyan is desaturated/darkened and used only for the primary action and online state; offline and alert states use semantic colors (red/amber family), not fuchsia and lime
Primary text is not pure white; secondary and tertiary text use a gray ladder and the response reports contrast ratios that meet 4.5:1 on the surfaces they sit on
Table header/meta text (originally slate-500/600 on slate-900) is lightened to pass 4.5:1
Only color and shadow values change; layout, content and Tailwind structure are otherwise untouched
Response states rendering was not verified

evals.name: already-fine-no-op
evals.prompt: 帮我看看这个订单页还能不能再优化一下，OrdersPage.vue。
evals.expected_output: 读完后判断页面已经满足任务：待处理列表是主体，主操作接单在行尾且是唯一实心色，状态用点加文字，等宽数字右对齐，有空态，对比度达标。结论是不需要改，列出检查过的项，至多给一两条标为可选的建议，不修改文件。
expectations: The file is not modified (no diff), or any change is limited to something the response identifies as a concrete defect with evidence
Response states plainly that the page does not need changes, before any suggestions
Response lists what was checked (hierarchy, primary action, status cues, numbers, empty state, contrast)
Any suggestions are at most two, explicitly marked optional, and not applied
Response does not invent problems from taste (radius, shadow, spacing tweaks without a stated defect)

evals.name: spec-overrides-skill-taste
evals.prompt: 这个概览页同事说有点 AI 味，帮我看看能不能改得舒服点。规范在 DESIGN.md。
evals.expected_output: 读到 DESIGN.md 后发现渐变横幅、四色指标卡、彩色图标底块都是规范明确要求的品牌表达，四色有业务含义。这些一律不动，也不改 DESIGN.md。只处理规范没覆盖的真实问题：金额 #9CA3AF 对白底 2.54:1 不达标（规范要求 4.5:1）。回复里说明哪些'AI 味'特征是规范要求所以保留，至多提一句可以和品牌团队讨论，并注明未渲染。
expectations: The gradient header banner is kept exactly as DESIGN.md specifies (linear-gradient #6D28D9 to #4F46E5, 96px, white title)
The four KPI cards keep their four spec-mandated tinted backgrounds
The row icon tiles are kept with their business-line colors
DESIGN.md is not modified
The one real defect is fixed: amount text #9CA3AF (2.54:1) is changed to a color meeting 4.5:1, with the ratio reported
Response explains that the gradient, tinted cards and icon tiles stay because the spec requires them and the colors carry meaning; at most one line suggests raising it with the brand team
Response states rendering was not verified

evals.name: from-scratch-order-list
evals.prompt: 用 React + Tailwind 写一个电商后台的订单列表页，运营每天在这里查订单、批量发货、点进单个订单看详情。字段有订单号、客户、金额、状态（待付款/待发货/已发货/已完成/已取消）、下单时间。先出一版能跑的。
evals.expected_output: 落到查询列表页的标准结构：页头（标题 + 新建/导出）、筛选区（状态、时间、关键字一行）、表格工具栏（结果数、批量发货、列设置）、表格（订单号等宽、金额右对齐等宽数字、状态用点 + 文字、行尾操作）、底部分页。不做订单卡片网格，不在表格上方放统计卡片。有空态。说明未渲染。
expectations: Page follows the list-page skeleton: header with primary action, filter row, table toolbar, table, pagination at the bottom
Orders are rendered as table rows, not as cards or a card grid
No statistics/KPI cards are placed above the table
Amount column is right-aligned with tabular-nums; order id uses tabular-nums
Status is shown as a dot plus text; at most one status (e.g. 待发货 or 已取消) carries a semantic color, the rest are neutral
Batch action (批量发货) lives in the table toolbar and depends on row selection; row-level actions sit in the last column
An empty state exists for zero results
Response states the page's user task, names the list-page pattern it followed, and says rendering was not verified
